evals.name: single-env-clean-deploy
evals.query: I just merged PR #4521. The monitoring plan is at docs/plans/4521-monitoring.md. Run rollout execution against the deploy.
expected_behavior: Reads the plan file from the path provided
Identifies the single environment listed in the plan
Begins polling the deploy system at 30-second cadence using the exact command from the plan's Deploy detection block
Emits a DEPLOY_DETECTED status block once the poll matches
Calls ScheduleWakeup for the next checkpoint offset (e.g. +10m) and yields, rather than busy-looping
On wake-up, runs each indicator query and emits a CHECK_COMPLETE block with the per-indicator verdicts
After the final checkpoint passes clean, emits the COMPLETED block including the explicit 'monitoring window closed' line

evals.name: multi-env-issue-in-staging
evals.query: Run /monitor-rollout on docs/plans/cache-rollout.md — staging deployed 5 minutes ago, prod is still in approval.
expected_behavior: Reads the plan and identifies both staging and prod as target envs
Records staging's deploy_time from the user's note (or polls and confirms it)
Continues polling prod (still in approval = not deployed)
At staging's +10m checkpoint, runs indicators with GROUP BY env (or per-env queries) and applies the four-check evidence-discipline gate
Detects a regression in staging that passes all four checks (assume the eval injects an error-rate spike well above threshold with prior-day evidence ruling out periodic patterns)
Emits an ISSUE_DETECTED status block that includes the plan's rollback hint copied verbatim
Calls EnterPlanMode with a seed plan derived from references/plan-mode-handoff.md
Notes prod as 'still polling for deploy' or 'monitoring deferred' in the report rather than continuing to monitor it during plan-mode

evals.name: evidence-discipline-rejects-false-positive
evals.query: Run the executor on the search-svc plan. Deploy went out at 8:50 PT this morning. Telemetry is via Datadog.
expected_behavior: At the +30m checkpoint, the search service's p99 latency reads 460ms (above the 280ms baseline)
Applies same-time-of-day comparison: prior-day at the same hour reads 470ms and 485ms
Concludes the elevated latency is part of the daily peak-hour pattern, not a regression
Marks the indicator as 'inconclusive' or 'unchanged' rather than 'regressed'
Includes the analytical reasoning in the CHECK_COMPLETE block's Notes column ('reading falls within prior-day range; routine peak-hour pattern')
Continues monitoring rather than handing off to plan mode

evals.name: telemetry-unreachable-graceful-degradation
evals.query: Run /monitor-rollout on docs/plans/api-v2.md. The Datadog API has been having issues today.
expected_behavior: At a checkpoint, attempts each indicator's Datadog query
When a query fails, retries once after ~10 seconds
Marks indicators that fail twice as INCONCLUSIVE with the failing query in the Notes column
Does NOT silently mark them as 'unchanged'
Continues with the rest of the indicators and other envs
If every indicator on every env fails for two consecutive checkpoints, escalates to FATAL_ERROR rather than continuing to emit empty CHECK_COMPLETE blocks
